usage: Native conversationMember operations selected by the accepted CRUD boundary. These are authored documentation-derived contracts, not captured PowerShell requests or live observations. Add/Get/Remove-TeamUser compositions use separate backing-group relationships.

rules.identity: membershipID is opaque and distinct from AAD userId; never decode or synthesize it
rules.create: AAD discriminator and selected-cloud user binding; roles may be omitted or explicit []; owner uses [owner]; guest is assigned by server
rules.update: only roles are writable; omitted means retained; [] demotes; [owner] promotes; null or [member] is not demotion; guest cannot be promoted
rules.list: filter/select/top; default page size 100, maximum 999; preserve nullable AAD fields, unknown subtypes/roles/properties and cross-tenant members
rules.writes: never replay ambiguous mutations; create is not asynchronous even though visibility can be delayed
rules.authority: application guest addition is unsupported; non-owner write permission does not imply owner authority
